## Checklist

- [ ] Tested on a device or emulator (screens touched by this PR)
- [ ] Does this add or change a user-facing feature? If yes:
  - [ ] the Android column in the server's [FEATURES.md](https://github.com/mtierltd/timetracker/blob/master/FEATURES.md) is updated (PR or issue linked here)
  - [ ] if the feature needs server support: it is checked via `ServerFeature` with the capability id from FEATURES.md, and hidden on servers that don't list it
- [ ] Does this depend on a server change? If yes, the server PR/issue is linked, and the app still works against the oldest supported server version
